metadata.proof: The ApiKey model defines an "expired" state but has no expires_at field and no code path ever sets status='expired'. ApiKey.make_secret() generates a long-lived credential (crm_ + 32-byte token_urlsafe). The hash is stored permanently. No scheduled job or background task transitions keys to expired. Any leaked or former-employee API key remains valid indefinitely until manually revoked.

In a production environment with thousands of organizations in watch/critical health or pending renewals, the entire result set is loaded into memory and passed to the template, causing memory/CPU spikes with no upper bound.

extra.message: Audit log returns every log entry without pagination

metadata.proof: The audit_log view (restricted to platform admin) uses .all() on the AuditLog table with no limit, offset, or pagination. Every audit event ever recorded is loaded into memory via a single queryset and passed to the template for rendering. In a long-running production instance where every create/update/delete action is logged, this causes unbounded memory consumption and generates an arbitrarily large HTTP response.
